checkpoint.scientific_limits:
All ten reviews are bounded class-level scientific reviews of unchanged records. Structural validation is separate from scientific support, and agent review is not human sign-off. Provider assertions, direct primary evidence, modeled mechanisms and source-availability limits remain distinguished in each bundle.

EC:2.1.1.339:
- The FIRST cohort reading covers 38 initial scopes: 4 complete normalized IUBMB pages, 6 whole UniProt JSONs, 9 whole CORE envelopes, 15 complete declared eight-field chemical scopes and 4 whole GO envelopes. This is cohort accounting; each record evidence list identifies its applicable sources.
- All first-four authority scopes and 13 declared policy scopes were personally read. FIRST 497 RDF rows/135 blocks and 35 edges/five balances were read and independently reconstructed; other cohort mechanical checks are not additional FIRST scientific evidence.
- Original source body paths, requested/resolved URLs, hashes, access instants and licensing context remain exact. A successful HTTP response is not itself experimental proof. Unobtained articles, image pixels, coordinates and separately linked supplements are excluded.
- Maintained EC/Rhea molecular-function and chemical-node conventions versus narrower schema descriptions remain a documented convention conflict, not a blanket target-typing defect.
- The focal hop study was read as a complete indexed envelope, not a newly obtained full article. Known prior XML/publisher retrieval limits are preserved and were not retried. The abstract supports in vitro regioassignment but not physiological accumulation of 4-O-methylxanthohumol in hop; an adjacent provider annotation tension does not become a defect in this correctly scoped target.

EC:2.1.1.342:
- The review is an agent scientific assessment, not human curator sign-off, source promotion or authority to alter records. Status provenance is assessed from the current target history, maintained emitter and bounded ignored-inclusive owner/history searches; it is not a claim that no human review exists anywhere.
- The authoritative node enum describes MOLECULAR_FUNCTION as a GO function and distinguishes CHEMICAL from ligand/substrate, while maintained molecular/Edison guidance explicitly permits EC/Rhea activity nodes and CHEMICAL substrates/products. The current graph follows those maintained conventions. This conflict limits categorical node-type interpretation and is not counted as a target defect; no automatic retyping to TRAIT or LIGAND is prescribed.
- Whole delivered UniProt and MED JSON and strict UTF-8 normalized IUBMB text were read; ChEBI reading is limited to the eight declared fields. Each record carries only its relevant primary article and availability scope. No figure-image bytes, separately linked supplementary file, PDB/mmCIF coordinate file or new sequence alignment was examined. Provider sites, indexed abstracts and retained authority statements retain their distinct evidence tiers.
- Bulk ENZYME, ec2go, rhea2ec, Rhea release 142 and policy captures are exact retained originals with their original timestamps and digests. They are not described as freshly downloaded current releases. Fresh endpoint envelopes and retained chemical scopes remain separately attributed.
- Class-level net reaction graphs do not prove elementary catalytic steps, cellular flux, substrate binding geometry or universal protein residue coordinates. Full external crossreferences and bibliography were read as context, without acquiring or endorsing every linked source.
- The PMC5087033 request returned HTTP 500 with a 150-byte Internal Server Error body. No ChuW full-article text, figures or detailed assay methods were inspected. The positive class assessment uses the complete current provider and indexed abstract with independently read authority/RDF chemistry; precise flavodoxin experimental conditions remain outside this review.
- FMNH2 and FMN are bound chemical cofactors, not claims of specific amino-acid or nucleotide sequence residues. This distinction does not invalidate the generic carrier or BFO part_of relation. No P32131-transferred coordination site is asserted as a newly verified A0A384LP51 site.
